FULL DEFAULT SELECTION IS GREEN — supplied by CI, which is what the earlier handoff comment was still owed.

The handoff comment above recorded that the local full-selection run had not completed (killed by the
harness on a saturated host, exit 144 — a kill, not a test result). That gap is now closed by CI, which
runs exactly the default selection plus both static gates:

  .github/workflows/_build-and-test.yml:81   run: make lint
  .github/workflows/_build-and-test.yml:109  run: make typecheck
  .github/workflows/_build-and-test.yml:462  pytest -m 'not integration and not external'   (the default selection)

Gerrit change 1282 (this ticket's change):
  * Patch Set 1 -> Verified-1, FAILURE https://github.com/navapbc/rebar/actions/runs/30782715365
  * Patch Set 2 -> Verified+1, SUCCESS https://github.com/navapbc/rebar/actions/runs/30783669146
  * Patch Set 3 = TRIVIAL_REBASE of Patch Set 2, submitted as 76ab5cebd22704e1ac22f9596d492835fcc12a8e
  * LLM-Review+1 (PASS, 3 advisory findings)

So the full default selection passed by exit code on this change's tree before it landed, and
76ab5cebd is an ancestor of origin/main HEAD (verified with git merge-base --is-ancestor).

Independently re-run on the merged tree just now, at origin/main = ec261532b:
  pytest -p no:randomly tests/unit/test_caplog_coverage_integrity.py (+ the 84aa and 12e4 test
  modules in the same process) -> 20 passed; tests/unit/test_review_bot.py -k configure_logging
  -> 4 passed.

AC-by-AC evidence for the record:
  AC1 established/recorded — the instrumentation comment above: 5 negative caplog assertions, all
      five reached with propagate=True over a full default-selection run, all five go red when the
      forbidden record is injected. 0 void.
  AC2 tests/unit/test_caplog_coverage_integrity.py::test_without_the_guard_the_void_assertion_passes_vacuously
      and ::test_with_the_guard_the_void_assertion_is_failed_and_named.
  AC3 blame at the source — tests/_log_integrity.py:55 propagation_failure(phase=...) plus
      ::test_teardown_phase_blames_the_test_that_disabled_propagation and
      ::test_the_guard_does_not_cascade_onto_an_innocent_later_test.
  AC4 nothing was void, so nothing needed restoring or deleting (see AC1).
  AC5 coordinated with b718: b718 removed the propagate=False poisoner in
      src/rebar/review_bot/config.py; this ticket's guard fails on propagation and CONTAINS the
      level vector (tests/_log_integrity.py:90 restore_level) — no overlapping mechanism.
